facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya says it runs the LYPay and OnePay instant payment services, launched in 2024, and will raise their transfer and purchase limits.

LBY.note: No government payment to people is stated.
Only subscriber and client counts are given, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya reports its LYPay service had 1,278,783 individual and 8,814 merchant subscribers and 102,059 purchases and transfers worth 285.8 million LYD from 1 August to 26 December 2024.
The Central Bank of Libya reports its OnePay service had 2,475,622 clients, 29,317 active merchants and 411,169 transactions worth 1,010,811,808 LYD from 1 August to 26 December 2024.

LBY.note: No tax or fee payment is stated.
